double t(int n, int h, vector<vector<double>>& dp) {
    if (dp[n][h] == -1) {
        double sum_value = 0.0;
        for (int m = 1; m <= n; ++m) {
            double part1 = t(m - 1, h - 1, dp) * 0;
            double sum_i1 = 0.0;
            for (int i = 0; i < h; ++i) {
                sum_i1 += t(n - m, i, dp);
            }
            double part2 = t(n - m, h - 1, dp) * 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < h - 1; ++i) {
                sum_i1 += t(m - 1, i, dp);
            }
            sum_value += t(m - 1, h - 1, dp) * sum_i1 + t(n - m, h - 1, dp) * sum_i1;
        }
        dp[n][h] = sum_value;
    }
    return dp[n][h];
}
